occurrenceChecks.text: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

wikiDecision.identityBasisJa: 記事中の「タルマイと兄弟たち」の項目はアナクの子孫を扱う。本カードは民数記13:22のタルマイに対応し、ゲシュル王の同名人物とは区別する。
